> *Generated by AI from docs/research/c-verification-macos.md.*

An opt-in mode (env or config) adding -fsanitize=address,undefined (or UBSan trap-only) -g -fno-omit-frame-pointer. Must enter the build cache key: in the spike an ASan build was silently reused by a later normal run and once replaced the library in _build/test/lib/defk/ebin (overlaps defk-srh). In this mode, poison the CHICKEN_PAD slack ERTS adds after enif_alloc_binary buffers in defk_own_raw so 1-byte overruns are caught on a stock emulator. Benchmarks (Defk.Bench) must refuse or warn in this mode.

comments.text:
Done in a2e493d (branch defk-96f.1/sanitizer-build-mode, not merged).

Interface: env var DEFK_SANITIZE = comma-separated address | undefined | trap (undefined+trap rejected; unknown values raise). Flags appended after @cflags (-O3 kept): address -> -fsanitize=address -fno-common -DDEFK_SANITIZE_ADDRESS=1; undefined -> -fsanitize=undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=undefined; trap -> -fsanitize=undefined -fsanitize-trap=undefined; all add -g -fno-omit-frame-pointer. Cache key gets the flags (normal key formula unchanged), lib name <Module>-<key>-san-<modes>.so, DEFK_SANITIZE in __mix_recompile__?. A Mix app's module refuses the mode unless MIX_BUILD_PATH is set (keeps sanitized beams+libs out of the normal _build/<env>). Defk.Bench.report/1 raises in the mode.

CHICKEN_PAD: defk_poison_slack in priv/defk_runtime.h (after enif_alloc_binary in defk_own_raw and after enif_realloc_binary in defk_bits_reserve): if __sanitizer_get_ownership(ref_bin), poison [data+size, ref_bin + __sanitizer_get_allocated_size(ref_bin)). Only ASan-owned chunks (+Mea min), empty on OTP's asan emulator. Normal builds: object code byte-identical to main's header (checked on 14 kernels' .c).

Working recipe on this Mac (macOS 26.7.1, Apple clang 21, asdf OTP 29.0.3 stock beam.smp), from the repo root:
  ASAN=$(cc -print-resource-dir)/lib/darwin/libclang_rt.asan_osx_dynamic.dylib
  MIX_ENV=test MIX_BUILD_PATH=_build/test_sanitize_address DEFK_SANITIZE=address \
    ERL_AFLAGS="-env DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES $ASAN +Mea min" mix test --max-cases 6
UBSan needs no insert: MIX_ENV=test MIX_BUILD_PATH=_build/test_sanitize_undefined DEFK_SANITIZE=undefined mix test ...
Notes: the -env/ERL_AFLAGS route is required (SIP strips DYLD_* from the asdf/erl shell scripts); +Mea min is required; one build path per mode (switching modes in one build path makes Mix load the old beams before recompiling, and an ASan library aborts a VM without the runtime: 'Interceptors are not working'). A stale normal build dir mixed with ASan libs gives the same abort: rm -rf the sanitizer build path.

Results: full suite under ASan: 1646/1667, 0 ASan reports; all 21 failures are mode artefacts (16 bench_test + 2 measuring.md doc examples = Bench refusal; release_layout_test x2 = the MIX_BUILD_PATH refusal / -san- lib name; bitstring_test:479 and raise_cleanup_test:54 = :erlang.memory(:binary) notsup under +Mea min; report_test:282 = .so.dSYM dir from -g). Clean subset (all files minus bench_test, release_layout_test, and --exclude of those 5 named tests): 1637 passed, 0 ASan reports, 70.5 s. UBSan subset (agreement, bitwise, u64, masked_arith, alloc_unzeroed): 293 passed, 0 runtime errors. Planted 1-byte overrun (flip/2 writing out[i+1], CC wrapper sed): 'use-after-poison ... WRITE of size 1 ... in run_k0_flip ...planted.c:60', allocated by enif_alloc_binary <- defk_own_raw, 132 bytes inside 139-byte region, exit 134; same kernel with -UDEFK_SANITIZE_ADDRESS: not detected (wrong result instead). Encoded as test/sanitize_test.exs --only sanitize. For 96f.2: tag those artefact tests so the run is green, and the dSYM copy in report_test.

title: Sanitizer build mode in Defk.Build (ASan/UBSan), part of the cache key, never used for benchmarks
